name: Brisa Family Dental
qualifierOptions: Texas Medicaid and CHIP for patients under 21
offers: New-patient special for patients without insurance: $79 exam, x-rays and cleaning.
Brisa Membership Plan: $299 per year, includes 2 cleanings and 20% off treatment.
Free consultation for implants and Invisalign.
extraNotes: Free parking in front. Spanish-speaking staff at the front desk.
